ambiguities: Saint-Loup tells the narrator directly that he would have preferred to spend the day alone with him ('j'aurais aimé que nous puissions, toi et moi, attendre ensemble... je n'ai pu lui refuser'), which briefly stages a fondness for the narrator's company, but this does not produce a distinct social outcome for the narrator beyond being addressed, so it was not scored as an event.
